reviews.text: The Dr. Pinney was informative yet receptive to our input. We feel very confident in his expertise and feel very supported in his care. Glad to finally have a practice we feel comfortable with. This practice is privately owned you can just feel the difference.

I had to take the time to leave a review because we had such a wonderful experience! I called ahead to ask them about their expertise with English Bulldogs, particularly ones with alopecia, and they assured me they've worked with several animals of this breed and condition. We were greeted with kindness by the employees, and immediately placed in a room. We met Dr. Pinney who genuinely cares about the animals. I also really appreciated how they were upfront about the cost of the visit before services continued. This is now our primary vet for our fur baby, Beaux. And if you are someone considering this clinic, I would suggest you visit them! Plus you'll see all the "thank you" notes hanging on the bulletin when placed in a room. Such a cute addition and shows how much people value them. Thanks so much! :)
Thank you for your 5 star review 🐾 …

I have two  american bully puppies amd i had them serviced here.  The staff is amazing .   Stephanie and Gully really took care of us the entire time.  They show so much love and care for the pets, and they are very professional.

Love Shadows  Family

Terrible experience. My dog is already an existing patient at this clinic, she has been there before and already has a medical file. However, when he developed an issue that needs attention now, I was told they don't accept walk-ins and that the next available appointment is not until Friday.

How is an existing patient supposed to get medical attention when something comes up unexpectedly? I understand that a clinic can have a busy schedule, but there should be some option for existing patients with urgent problems to be evaluated by a veterinarian.

Honestly, this was extremely frustrating and disappointing. It makes me feel like the focus is more on maintaining a convenient schedule and making easy money than on actually being available when an animal needs medical care.

This is not the kind of support I expect from a veterinary clinic. Very disappointing.

I just want to say how awesome and patient Stephaine and Dr. Pinney were with my dog Ludwig for his annual visit. He is a feisty little man that can be bought with treats apparently. Thank you again for being so kind to my boy. His care and well-being means alot to me and I'm glad that I found MPC to take care of him. Thank you again!

MPC Veterinary Care is top notch!
Great staff, great Vets!
Some might say, "They are out of this world! "

Initially my first visit went well. The vet and her assistant were friendly and told me my chihuahua was fine and offered to cut her nails. She asked if I had any questions or concerns? I took my dog  because she had not peed all day and she was swollen from her heat cycle. I was worried about a uti. So when the vet asked I said yes I have another concern when I travel she gets car sick and any  medication would be helpful for that. She offered some meds and we went home. Then years have passed maybe three years. My dog got sick, vomit and diarrhea. Of course that never happened before other than when she travels but this was in the morning at home. So I took her back because it went well before. This time a male vet came in very irritated. I was crying because I was already worried. Only for him to throw remarks about how I already brought my dog in for stomach issues and basically I was a bad pet parent and To stop giving her fatty food or table scraps. What is crazy is my dog never liked dry kibble, so I only fed her boiled chicken, turkey, or quail. Some veggies since she is really picky. So for him to assume that based off my looks alone is concerning or didn’t read the notes well from a previous visit but it was offensive. I found out from another friend her dog gets that way if she doesn’t eat in a timely manner and I remembered we got home later than usual so my dog ate her chicken and rice later than usual and had acid reflux. Now of course I always make it home on time and no issues since! I will not be going back and if I have to I won’t be so nice.
Tamara was absolutely AMAZING wit my kitty Gracie. If you are looking for a place for your animals please come here!!! Affordable and friendly!! Thank you Tamara Gracie thanks you ❤️
DR. PINNEY. ANDREA. THE WHOLE TEAM. IS AMAZING. Thank you for the patience, care and love you provide to the mommies/daddies and especially our fur babies!!!
Wonderful staff  and the amount of care for my Luci & myself was amazing. Empathetic people all around. I’m glad I brought my dog here, they were so patient and provided wonderful service.

Moving back to Texas meant comparing the vets in the area and choosing the right one, with MPC we've definitely found that. My puppy Everest broke a nail and was impossible to inspect or treat at home, MPC is his primary vet for his care but we've never had an injury, they got us scheduled quick with care tips and emergency info until the appointment. He's always been treated kind and been comfortable with this clinic, that they handled his injured paw so well with care and post treatment information has only improved our appreciation of this location, he's so much happier today after being treated, a wonderful clinic and staff.

MCP Vet provided exceptional care to our beloved Zena in her time of need. Their team treated her with gentleness, dignity, and genuine compassion, and we are deeply grateful for the support they gave our family during such a difficult moment.The sympathy card they created for us — complete with her paw and nose prints and heartfelt messages from the staff — meant more than words can express. It showed how much they truly cared for her and how deeply they understood what she meant to us.We are thankful for their kindness, their professionalism, and the love they showed Zena throughout her life and especially at the end. MCP Vet is a team that goes above and beyond, and we will always remember the comfort they provided.

My dog and I had a wonderful experience with Dr. Pinney and his vet technician, Shelley. They were both incredibly kind, patient, knowledgeable, and compassionate throughout my dog’s visit. I truly appreciated how gentle and caring they were with my dog and how thoroughly they explained everything. It was clear that they genuinely care about the animals they treat. I’m so grateful for their kindness and would highly recommend them to anyone looking for a caring and knowledgeable vet team.
Amazing service. Super empathetic and polite. Andrea is an amazing tech. 10/10 would recommend this practice for their outstanding service and affordable prices.

Thoughtful, courtious and a fair price.  I have taken my pup in for a few needs and MPC staff are some of the best I've had take care of my pooch.  From prescriptions to checkups and even photo ops as a bonus, there's not much more I can expect without the moon being included.
Great experience. Very nice and helpful. Took great care of our dog

I took my chihuahua Leila in for presurgical labwork and then a deep teeth cleaning, including a few extractions.  Both visits were the absolute best that they could be.  All of the staff members treated both of us is very well. It goes without saying that Dr. Pinney is a boss! You can tell that he not only knows, but loves his profession. I want to give a special shout out to Andrea, who I now consider to be my "Angel". She treated and cared for Leila as if she were her own.  You can tell by her demeanor that she enjoys what she does. Andrea went above and beyond her clinical duties and I will never, ever forget  her professionalism, attention to detail, and her kind, as well as, gentle nature.  Andrea called the day after Leila's procedure to check on her and patiently answered my plethora of questions. Today, Leila's loose two front teeth are gone and she can no longer whistle, but we will get over that minor hurdle.  Just kidding!!  Leila is doing great!!! She is eating as though she didnt have a procedure at all. Her teeth are sparkling and her breath is undetectable.  YAY!!!!! Being a repeat customer is always based on my last visit and I will say to anyone who reads this ....I am definitely going back as I have time and time again. Hugs to the staff and an extra hug to Andrea.  Leila and I are grateful to you all for being there when we need you.

Update: 6-23-3026

I had a visit for lab tests for my cat, Smokey. Corey, who was at the desk at the time, made us feel welcome and immediately got the ball rolling.  Andrea, who is a superstar, took care of the testing and kept my little one as calm as ever.  My visit was fast and the service was top-notch.  Smokey required medication and Corey went above and beyond to research information regarding those meds. Andrea, as usual, gave the most personal customer service one could ask for.  She treats my pets as if they were her own.  If you have a dog and/or cat and they have never been seen at MPC, they are missing out on quality health care by empathic and caring staff.  Ive tried several vets in San Antonio, but I keep going back to MPC. When you know, you know.
Thank you so much for the 5 star review!

I’ve been bringing my two cats to MPC for almost two years now (since I got them). It has been a great experience. The wonderful vet techs and Dr. Pinney always consult you about prices before doing anything, they are kind and transparent about the procedures and diagnoses, and they really do care.

Dr. Pinney and his staff saved my boy’s life. I don’t know who it was, but someone there saw what I put on the online form for the appointment and called to have me come in ASAP. Thank goodness they did!!

Dr. Pinney correctly diagnosed my boy with FIP and consulted me about going to an animal hospital. He and the vet techs were sensitive and considerate both to me (sobbing in the exam room) and about the options I had (including handling the financial topic of an overnight facility). He also mentioned this new “experimental” (it’s manufactured by a legit pharmacy, just hasn’t been FDA approved yet) medicine that ended up saving my sweet boy.

(For those who don’t know, before this drug, FIP had a 100% fatality rate.)

I decided to take him to the animal hospital. (Thankfully I had pet insurance.) I knew to bring up the experimental drug thanks to Dr. Pinney, and the emergency vets were willing to try it. I paid for ultra express delivery, and once he started on it, his appetite came back and his numbers got better! It’s almost a year later now, and he is alive and well!

I am so incredibly grateful to MPC Vet. Thank you!!

The best veterinary clinic in San Antonio!

I called because my dog was dealing with a severe cough, and they were able to get me an appointment the same day.

Dr. Pinney was very attentive and took the time to thoroughly examine my dog, explain the treatment plan, and work within my budget to provide the best care at an affordable cost.

The vet tech, Andrea, was absolutely phenomenal! She took great care of my senior dog throughout the entire visit—from taking his temperature to assisting with the X-ray and physical exam. She was kind, gentle, and made him feel as comfortable as possible.

Thank you for taking such great care of Shorty!
Thank you for the 5 stars! We truly appreciate your support.
Thank you so much for the 5 star review!

The tech, Andrea, and Dr. Pinney were phenomenal! They fit us in within 24 hours when my pup needed stitches redone from an emergency visit. It was excellent care and still affordable. I will be moving all 3 of my dogs under their care.

Hands down the best vet I’ve ever taken my dogs to! All of the staff is incredibly friendly and both of my dogs feel comfortable going here. I’ve taken my dogs here numerous times and never once have I waited longer than 5 minutes to be seen. My larger dog is a rescue and is incredibly timid and I have been turned away by other places due to the staff not feeling comfortable handling him. MPC immediately made him feel comfortable/ safe. He’s been back several times and isn’t scared to go in the door like other places I’ve taken him. This goes to show the level of care/ comfort they provide. I also appreciate how informed the staff keeps you. They provided photo updates for me as well as a phone call update while I waited to pick my pet up after is procedure/injections. I can’t recommend them enough. They also will show you prices of everything prior to any services so that you know ahead of time what your bill will be. 10/10 service👏
Thank you so much for the 5 star review!

I recently took in a stray that I rescued and they treated her like a queen! She is very very timid and scared right now and they were so gentle and comforting to her. She is all taken care of and got her in and out quickly! Highly recommend this vet will definitely be coming back and taking my other dogs here. Prices seem reasonable but would have paid whatever to get this sweet girl taken care of. 10/10 experience!
Dr. Penney and his staff always take great care of me and my fur babies.
Thank you so much for the review!

Visited clinic with my Husky, our main concern was a bump on his back. We were very pleased with the service, they end up recommending removing the bump due to its location and look - we were able to schedule a removal in a few days and all went perfectly fine!

Also the next day after surgery they called us in the morning to check on my pup and make sure everything is okay - which was very thoughtful.

Anyway definitely recommend this clinic the staff, technicians and doctors are very attentive and knowledgeable!
Thanks so much for the 5 stars!
Thank you for the 5 stars! We truly appreciate your support. 🐾 …
Super Vet and Crew - On the Weekends the price is less ~ be sure to Call and find out where they will be on a Weekend Low Cost Day.
You won't find a better Vet in San Antonio. I've visited them many times and it's always a pleasure, and the prices are more than competitive. I don't think you should go to any other vet.
Good and human treatment to my baby boy, Luigi. Thank you for your patience and thank you for your hard work.
I seem to care more about my dogs pain. I will surely take her back there
Thank you so much for the 5 star review!
Always professional and caring
Everyone is so nice and welcoming. Andrea & Dr. Pinney have made us feel like family. Huge thank you to them both for taking the time to help us with our pup.
Have been coming here for over a year. You can tell doc really cares. Does not feel like a chain vet like other places.
Nice Clinic, very clean and orderly. The techs could be a little more engaging and talk to people.
Love these people, always kind and sweet to the animals

Took my pup here for her check up and vaccination. We were met and greeted as soon as we walked in. We didn’t not waited too long to be place in the examining room . Veterinarian and vet technician heard all my concerns and answered all my questions. They made my pup n I feel right at home we will be making MPC Veterinary Care our to go for care .

This afternoon, I came to MPC Veterinary Care for the first time for my cat Whimsy, who hasn't had much of an appetite the past couple weeks due to stress from our recent move from California.

After drawing Whimsy's blood, Dr. Pinney and his assistant came in and assessed her. Once the bloodwork results came in, Dr. Pinney explained them to me and offered me solutions.

I am very happy with the care that my Whimsy received today. Not only did it alleviate my anxiety to find out the bloodwork results in a timely manner, but I also felt like Dr. Pinney and his vet tech really cared for my Whimsy. They were very caring, professional, and thorough in addressing my concerns. In addition, costs were very reasonable. It was my first time at this vet clinic, and it won't be my last! They've definitely earned my trust.

I highly recommend MPC Veterinary Care if you are looking for a vet clinic whose staff is both knowledgeable and caring to your animals!

Very professional, but they also make you feel like you are just talking to someone you know. They are very kind and gentle with the dogs and they are always quick to answer questions and help you understand.
Jasper had a great visit i’m really proud how comfortable he was. Dr. Penny and Shelly were very patient with Jasper and super nice.

What a wonderful experience! We brought our dog in yesterday with a few concerns and we’re easily reassured that our pup was fine and healthy. The vet and the vet assistant were calm, listened thoroughly to our concerns and were loving towards our dog. I cannot recommend this place highly enough!

Great staff !
Great Doc !
Great service & very personable !

I've been really disappointed with MPC. My dog has always loved going to the vet but is scared of MPC. We might just be used to cities that handle dogs differently, but I've never been to a primary care vet where the rooms have steel tables with no padding and no treats for the dogs. I also just got inaccurate information from vets and vet techs here a lot, minor things, but it was weird to hear a vet discourage me from giving my dog pupperoni because it has pork, when pupperoni is made from beef liver. Last straw was them refusing to refill my dog's pain meds when they knew he was hurting. The vet tech and manager told me "the vet's notes say if his pain worsens, you need to go to the ER, not get more meds." Then I got my hands on the vet's notes, which literally said "pain meds recommended regardless" and the only reference to the ER said to go if my dog became paralyzed. I spent hours at the emergency vet and hundreds of dollars extra to end up with the exact same prescription after they lied to me about the vet's notes.

Edit: Reduced from 2 stars to 1 because they lied in the response.

Been going for a couple years after my old vet wouldn’t even let us see them take out cats temp. They do so much (as much as they can) with you and your pet together, Techs are so kind and just relieving to know they actually care about your animals, Vet Doctor is down to earth and genuinely cares/remembers your pets! Also, they show you the price before anything is done to make sure it’s in budget and you’re in the know! No payment plans available so keep that in mind BUT they are soooo affordable and don’t price gouge like most vets. Glad to have found y’all and worth driving the 1hr since I moved, should have wrote this review after the 1st appointment :)
Thank you so much for the 5 stars! We truly appreciate your support and trust in our team. 🐾❤️ …

My little 10 lb dog Leo (12 yrs) need  his teeth cleaned with teeth extracted and a mass removal on leg.  His surgery went well.  HIs teeth were cleaned ( his teeth are shine & new again) and his infected teeth removed. They were able to save 12 of his teeth.  He got excellent care  and procedures were explained .  Leo was a happy camper on pick up from hospital.  Dr. H. Pinney and Andrea were excellent in taking care of Leo. All staff is professional with friendly clean atmosphere.
So happy to have found this veterinarian so close to home. Dr. Pinney and his staff are all awesome, and the attention they gave my cat was incredible!

I’ve taken my dog here several times, and every visit has been a great experience. The staff is always friendly, patient, and thorough during examinations. They take their time and make sure all of my questions are answered. As a sweet extra touch, they even gave my dog a bandana and took her picture on Halloween. We truly appreciate the care and attention they give!

My dog Whitney has a tendency to be scared of all humans. At times she comes off as very aggressive and doesn’t let anyone near us. I love the fact that when I took her to MPC, they were able to calm her down and get her to become even more responsive with them, they were even able to take her leash and walk her around with me not being around. I was amazed on their compassion, their speediness, and the fact that they were able to take care of her earache they gave her treats they walked her and they did it for such a great price is only $90 for her medication as well.
Thank you MPC.
Nugget is all EARS for MPC Veterinary Care!! Thank u all for taking the time and care of Nugget.  We definitely appreciate it....and I know she does too!!
All I can say is everyone that works at MPC is amazing. They take the best care of my fur babies and I wouldn't take them anywhere else.

Best vet ever!! We have an older dog that has, issues, and they always treat him with such care and love! We also have a younger dog, and she's so active but never seems to bother or annoy them! Even when it's busy they make sure you don't feel rushed pressured!

The MPC team and Dr. Hunter are truly exceptional. They treat both you and your pets with genuine care, compassion, and attention to detail. The entire staff takes the time to explain everything clearly and thoroughly, and they genuinely listen to your concerns.

I’ve confidently chosen them as the primary care team for my two cats, and I couldn’t be happier with the level of service they provide. If I could give them 10 stars, I absolutely would.

Highly, Highly recommended — without a doubt!
The full MPC Vet Team is the best. They are very gentle and caring with my fur babies. Dr. Hunter Pienny is awsome. We can see the care and attention he provides for each of his fur patients. 🐕❣️

I love how sweet everyone is here! I have been to vet offices before and they were never as attentive and kind as everyone at MPC. Super communicative and great availability. Also very cost effective!!

Life-saving care and true compassion!
A huge thank you to Dr. Pinney and the entire team at MPC Veterinary Care! My German Shepherd puppy, Rowdy, was getting weaker by the day—he had stopped eating, was vomiting, and showed no signs of improvement. We brought him in on Thursday, and after an exam, bloodwork, and a pancreatitis test, nothing obvious showed up. He was given medication and told to come back if things didn’t improve.

By Friday, he was worse, so we returned. Dr. Pinney suspected a possible obstruction, and although the x-rays were inconclusive, he didn’t hesitate to recommend exploratory surgery. Despite his full schedule, he fit us in immediately—and thank God he did. The surgery revealed and removed a dangerous obstruction. Without it, Rowdy likely wouldn’t have made it.

The entire staff, especially Andrea (who kept us updated), Sunny, and Cory, showed such compassion and professionalism. They treated Rowdy like family—and treated us with kindness and respect every step of the way.

I’m happy to say Rowdy was already back to his happy, hungry self the very next day!

It was a busy Friday, and they could’ve referred us elsewhere—but they didn’t. That means everything. I can’t recommend MPC Veterinary Care enough. They truly have hearts of gold. Thank you all!
I'm running out of money. And it doesn't help than my 13yo puppy cost me $600 here.
I love this office every one is super nice and made sure my little dog was comfortable even though she’s super nervous around new people
Our staff greatly appreciates you taking the time to leave our clinic a five star review! Thank you!!

I want to thank everyone here for them being so kind and helpful during my fur babies first vet visit! All of you are amazing!  I was worried how she would react being in a different environment, but she did great.
Friendly staff!
Clean friendly caring  very professional  Noel was thorough  Dr zpinney  very thorough  answered all my questions  caring   will go again   Thk u Mpc
Very thorugh examination of my cat, swift fillowup of test results. Very kind and compassionate!

Dr. Pinney and Andrea and the rest of the staff were amazing! Always taking care of my sweet baby Daisy. Have been for the last 5 years. Extremely grateful for their work, thank you for all that you do.

I recently moved from Austin back to San Antonio and needed a new veterinarian for my dog. I was fortunate to find Dr. H. Pinney and Shelly, the veterinary technician, and I couldn’t be more impressed. They both spent a significant amount of time with me and carefully explained all of my dogs health concerns. Dr. Pinney explained what truly needed treatment and what could be monitored. He was refreshingly, honest and even recommended holding off on certain things to keep costs reasonable, which is a rare and much appreciated approach in veterinary care. The prices are substantially more affordable than my previous veterinarian, but the quality of care and communication was still outstanding. As a physician myself, I was especially impressed with how clearly Dr. Pinney and Shelly both explained complex medical issues in a way that anyone could understand. I left feeling confident and reassured that my dog is in excellent hands. I would highly recommend them to anyone looking for compassionate, thorough, and trustworthy, veterinary care!

The BEST! We are endlessly grateful for MPC and Dr. Pinney, Sunny, and the whole team. My dog gets extremely anxious at the vet, so we truly appreciate a smaller, calmer office with a quiet lobby. The staff’s knowledge of fear-free handling and dog body language made all the difference. Everyone was so kind, patient, and welcoming.

Lucky and Cosmo are patients at MPC for a few years now. We started at the Mobile Clinic and became patients at the brick & mortar location. The office is super clean and nice. The staff is friendly. Dr. Pinney is patient, gentle and friendly. They don't try to add frivolous expenses. The mobile pet care clinic at Locke Hill Feed is super convenient. The online pharmacy is super easy to navigate. Put both my dogs on auto ship and the prices are unbeatable. We love MPC and their staff!

I wish I could give them a million stars…Hands down the best place to take your pets too! It’s so relieving to have finally found a trustworthy place I can take my babies too! Dr. Hunter Pinney and all the staff members genuinely care and love every pet that walks in, they are transparent the entire time, they never add anything unnecessary just to make extra money, they always have the exam room ready at the time of the appointment so no waiting time, they are very thorough and efficient. This vet clinic has the perfect balance; optimizing the care for animals, along with, taking into consideration the financial constraints of the owner. Words can’t express how thankful I am for MPC Veterinary Care!

From Groot, Pinky and myself- Thank you so much, Dr. Hunter Pinney and all staff members! 💜

Had a recent visit at MPC Veterinary Care for my baby Bubba’s teeth. I am so happy and just absolutely thankful for the team you have here. Everyone was super attentive and kind with every question that came up during the appointment and even after his teeth cleaning procedure. I want to especially give a thank you to Andrea she was the definition of exceptional. She went above and beyond from explaining everything with detail regarding his procedure to answering all my questions with so much patience and care. I could not be happier with all my services and I definitely would recommend this veterinary care clinic to any pet parent. Thank you so much !!!

I have a new cat that just showed up and adopted our household. He needed to be checked for a chip, shots and he hurt his paw. I was so stressed for him. The staff, the vet, and Shelly were fantastic. They were so careful make certain he was not afraid and stressed out. Shelly was fantastic, explaining everything and helping him stay calm. I really appreciate Cory following up on how my cat was doing. I felt confident in the care given to my cat. He is doing great.

Thanks so much MPC, for being able to see my cat the same day and allay my concerns about his belly wound. Reaching out to my old vet on the east coast to confer, listening to my concerns, and taking such good care of us both! I would gladly recommend you to any and all of my friends and family!! I’ve found my cats new care providers.

We have had only amazing experiences with Dr. Pinney and staff. They are so helpful and so patient. Even when we had an accident at the groomer, they helped us and treated our pup with such love. We couldn’t be more thankful. 1000% recommend.

Thank you MPC Veterinary Care! Dr. H Pinney and Andrea took such good care of our girl, Coco. They both explained care and medications so clearly and made sure to prioritize Coco’s comfort and care. Great primary care center!

We had such a great experience at the clinic with Dr. H. Pinney and Andrea! They were both incredibly kind, patient, and thorough. You can really tell they care about the animals and take the time to explain everything clearly. Andrea was especially warm and gentle, helping our pet feel calm and safe throughout the visit. She’s great!!Thank you both for making it such a positive experience. We truly appreciate it!

Best vet we've ever been to. We have brought 2 stray cats and our own cat to this vet and they've attended each one with amazing care and attention to detail. They always listen and are incredibly upfront and honest in their opinion and treatment plans. Office staff, technician staff, and Dr. Pinney are very kind, knowledgeable, and show great care in the animals we have brought in. Clean, comfortable facility and affordable as well! Couldn't recommend them enough!
Technicians and vet truly care about animals, staff is polite and helpful. Appointments start on time! Great care and tips for older dogs.
We love this office and staff they’re very attentive and helpful and don’t gouge on services either which having 5+ rescues is helpful

Dr. Pinney and his staff has always taken the best care of our now 14-year old German Shepherd mix, Jax. They've done multiple surgeries and always had his best interest at heart.  My love goes out to all of the staff there, and my sincerest gratitude always.

Amazing place, I was really scared my cats had lily poisoning and they saw me almost immediately. I had called an emergency vet and they told me it would be $6000 for both cats to save their lives, they helped my peace of mind for a quarter of the cost. The staff was so sweet and knowledgeable, they were supportive and I’m making them my primary clinic.

They are great! My dog, Leo, gets really anxious going to the vet. But they were so patient with hi. And even were able to trim his nails! (He absolutely dislikes it). They are great, thank you Andrea and Dr. Pinney

This was our first time there. Never have we had such a thorough check up. Andrea was so nice and patient with my fur baby. Everything was explained so well. Dr. Pinney took his time in the check up and explained everything. We didn’t miss a thing! I’m so thankful. We will definitely keep coming. You can see they truly care. Thank you Dr. Pinney and Andrea❤️🙏

What troopers at MPC!  My weenie doggie did NOT want his nails clipped but peanut butter on a stick & 2 great techs did the trick & my doggie ended up so happy & with short nails again!  Thank U Brian & staff for ur patience with my fur baby!
From all the clinics we've been to, this has been the most helpful.
Thank you so much for the 5 star review!

I cannot put into words how grateful I am for the team at MPC, I took my cat in today after having some issues with blood in his urine and they are nothing but amazing here.
I had recently taken my cat somewhere else to get treated who showed no sympathy towards me and my partner and were more interested in money. You can tell at MPC they have the animals care as their top priority and it shouldn’t be any other way. This is for sure be my go to clinic from this day forward for any questions or concerns for my cat and dogs ❤️

Compassionate, transparent and professional care

I've been bringing all five of my dogs to MPC Veterinary Care for many years now, and I can't speak highly enough about the consistent, high quality care we've received.  Most recently, I took one of my dogs in to have a small mass checked out, and once again, Dr Pinney and team went above and beyond.

Dr Pinney was incredibly thorough and took the time to explain all of our options. Rather than pushing one solution, he offered a thoughtful range-from a less invasive course of antibiotics to a surgical removal option- along with a clear and reasonable estimate. I really appreciated having all the information to make the best decision for my dog.

What really stood out, though, was how much the whole staff truly cares.  Shelley, in particular, went out of her way to make my dog feel comfortable and at ease.  It's rare to find that level of genuine compassion, and it made a world of difference for both of us.

The clinic is clean, organized and welcoming and it's clear that everyone there is committed to excellent care.  I highly recommend Dr. Pinney and MPC Veterinary Care to anyone looking for a veterinary team they can trust!

We’ve had consistently great experiences with this clinic. Shelley, the vet tech, is always amazing—so compassionate and helpful every time we visit. We’re especially grateful that Dr. Pinney was able to fit our cat in for surgery on short notice. He was not only kind and reassuring, but also incredibly knowledgeable and curious about advancements in veterinary medicine. It’s clear the staff genuinely cares about both animals and their people. Thank you for everything!
I Give M.P.C. (Mobile Pet Care) 5 Stars 5 Out Of 5 Great People & Great Place 2 Take Your Furrbaby
Thank you so much for the 5 star review!

I cannot express enough how grateful I am for the team at MPC. Dr. Pinney, Shelley, Brian, Alina, and the entire team (I wish I knew everyone’s names) have always been incredibly compassionate and helpful every visit.
